decision: Split A1-EFFICIENCY from A1-CAPACITY before any further computation.
A1-EFFICIENCY must report all registered 20k 30k and 40k budget points; neither positive nor negative results may become capacity GO or NO-GO.
LD-block is eligible only for a future confirmatory capacity experiment using a 30k horizon supported by 30k-to-40k out-of-sample persistence.
Longrange capacity is INCONCLUSIVE_BUDGET_NOT_ESTIMABLE and longrange efficiency is descriptive only.
The independent replication unit is data_seed; checkpoints mask seeds and init seeds are not data-seed replicates.
Historical dispersion is planning proxy only and cannot replace an n=5 data-seed pilot.
With unknown covariance use SD(A-B) no larger than SD(A)+SD(B) as the conservative planning bound; sqrt(2) is not an unconditional bound.
H=5 tail-slope and 0.3 times delta_min were not registered in v7.2.4 and may support stopping or planning only.
Constant-LR adequacy rules cannot be reused in a WSD or cosine-decay segment.
The 30k-to-30.25k change is a boundary-associated upper bound not a pure resume discontinuity estimate.
Future confirmatory runs should avoid resume; unavoidable resume requires same-checkpoint same-mask evaluation before optimizer update.
This release is CPU-only and authorizes no GPU work formal A1-R n=5 pilot HAPNEST holdout or HGDP access.
